name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot lets agents search and read contacts, companies, deals and tickets, and create or update records, associations, notes and tasks. HubSpot's own local server runs with a service key from your HubSpot account. The scopes of the key set what agents can read and change. The server has no delete tools.

prompts.text: Summarize my open deals by stage and amount.
What do we know about the contacts at this company?
Add a note about today's call to this contact in HubSpot.

apps.name: HubSpot
apps.description: CRM search, record and association updates, notes and tasks, over HubSpot's local MCP server with a service key.

fields.label: Service key
fields.hint: In HubSpot, open Development > Keys > Service keys, create a key with the CRM scopes you need, and copy it. A private app access token also works.
